audited_statement: For finite-field subspace arrangements with k distinct geometric subspace classes and arbitrary positive multiplicities, exact path-width is computable by a ternary endpoint-state bottleneck DP with at most 3^k states and O(k*3^k) transition work after 2^k subset-rank preprocessing.

primary_prior_context.reference: Jeong-Kim-Oum, The art of trellis decoding is fixed-parameter tractable, arXiv:1507.02184
primary_prior_context.relevance: General subspace-arrangement layout problem; FPT construction parameterized by target width over a fixed finite field.

primary_prior_context.reference: Kashyap, Matroid Pathwidth and Code Trellis Complexity, arXiv:0705.1384
primary_prior_context.relevance: Relates representable matroid pathwidth and code trellis-width; proves general representable-matroid pathwidth NP-hard.

novelty_reason: Unlike the duplicate-subspace lemma, the DP result uses two nontrivial structural steps not supplied by the base definition alone: endpoint compression for arbitrary k repeated geometric classes, and a bottleneck dynamic program over ternary Done/Active/NotStarted states together with the subset-rank identity lambda(P,S)=rho(S)+rho(K\P)-rho(K).
